name: Distill sample corpus
note: Every organisation and figure here is fictional. The set is deliberately inconsistent about field naming and date format; see decision D67.

documents.why: Baseline invoice with a purchase order. Says 'Vendor', 'Total due'.
Second invoice from the same vendor, so 'total by vendor' has to group.
Calls it 'Supplier', 'Invoice No', 'Grand total'. No purchase order.
Plain text, no layout to lean on. No purchase order.
Scanned image, so the Optical Character Recognition path runs. No PO.
Two pages of prose. Answers 'what does the contract say about payment terms' and explains why a missing purchase order matters.
Prose that is not about invoices at all, so the schema cannot quietly become an invoice schema.
Different fields entirely: account number, closing balance, no vendor.
Tabular reference data with no amounts, so it cannot distort the totals.
